instruction: Fix `median` in `numstats/descriptive.py` so it returns the average of the two middle values for even-length input. For `[1, 2, 3, 4]` it currently returns `3` instead of `2.5`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats/descriptive.py b/numstats/descriptive.py
--- a/numstats/descriptive.py
+++ b/numstats/descriptive.py
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@
     mid = n // 2
     if n % 2 == 1:
         return ordered[mid]
-    return ordered[mid]
+    return (ordered[mid - 1] + ordered[mid]) / 2
